thought.text: The dev flow routes via `host.docker.internal` (backend on host port 3030, frontend on 5173). Let me verify that resolves, and check migrate progress.

reasoning_content: I need to verify that `host.docker.internal` resolves properly to 172.17.0.1 in the container network, since the dev backend and frontend run on the host at ports 3030 and 5173 respectively. Let me also check the migration status.

action.command: docker run --rm --entrypoint sh alpine -c "getent hosts host.docker.internal || echo NO_RESOLVE" 2>&1; echo "=== migrate log ==="; tail -8 /tmp/migrate.log; echo "=== migrate proc ==="; ps aux | grep -E "cargo build|migrate" | grep -v grep | head -3
